title: Free lead sample
criteria: One free researched training-provider profile and five additional UK training-provider profiles, each with a published business contact route, observed certificate workflow, original sources, proposed batch-generation use and tailored opening.

leads.business_need: The 2.5-hour Basic Barista Course includes a participation certificate. The course page says certificates are posted the following week and publishes reservation dates and a direct email.
leads.why_it_fits: After the tutor confirms attendance, the class roster could populate a batch of the school's own participation certificates, with a staff review before the existing print-and-post step.
leads.opening_message: Hi BARistaBARBAR team — your Basic Barista Course page says participation certificates are posted the following week. Would a short example of preparing a class's print-ready certificates from one spreadsheet be useful? You would keep your current wording and approve attendance before generating the batch.
leads.status_note: Discuss the school's own Basic Course participation certificate. Preserve its existing wording, approval and postal process; establish current batch preparation and whether a reusable CSV mapping would help.
